## [1.10.1](https://github.com/FoxxoOwO/foxxo-patches/compare/v1.10.0...v1.10.1) (2026-11-21)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **ascent:** patch the correct s81 variant in premium mapper ([4b9e62c](https://github.com/FoxxoOwO/foxxo-patches/commit/4b9e62c0b67636c2947b68cc91f1b4f6831d683d))

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks Ascent Premium. The subscription status the app reports to its UI is always "premium" (server answer, cached state and first-launch mapping), and the Play license check is disabled so the re-signed build does not shut itself down.

apps.developer: Screen Time & Focus apps developers — AscentTeam

patches.name: Chat only
patches.description: Turns Instagram into a chat-only messenger: opens Direct instead of the feed and removes the home feed, Reels, Explore, ads and suggestions, while the Stories tray stays visible. Long-press any bottom tab (or the Direct title) to open the Feurstagram settings.

patches.name: Clone
patches.description: Renames the package and app label so the patched build installs alongside a stock Instagram instead of replacing it.

options.description: A new package name for the patched app.
A new app name (label). Entering "Instagram" skips changing the label.

patches.name: Debug bridge
patches.description: Development only: exposes the Feurstagram settings over ADB broadcasts so they can be driven from a shell instead of the on-screen panel.

patches.name: Unlock all DLC
patches.description: Unlocks every expansion. The purchase lookup returns the game's own list of all DLC, so no store session or receipt is involved. Only the arm64 build is patched.
